name: Manatsu ~MANATSU~
source:
A corpse is rolling on the floor. Its temperature makes blood freeze, and its facial expression is distorted with surprise and agony.
When truth is revealed, memories start to come back with the speed of a lightning.

What's waiting ahead - death or salvation?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一具尸体在地板上打滚。它的温度让血液凝固，它的面部表情因惊讶和痛苦而扭曲。
当真相被揭开时，记忆开始以闪电般的速度恢复。

前方等待着什么——死亡还是救赎？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
